name: Voxel Overworld (FireRed / LeafGreen)
description: The FireRed and LeafGreen overworld as a 3D diorama: every metatile extruded into real geometry, walked by a depth-buffered tilted camera, with the characters standing up as sprite cards, lit by a sun and moon that follow the time of day. Presentational only -- it changes what the map looks like, never where anybody stands.
